project_type: Multi-repo implementation: TypeScript Lambda backend (moovv-fit-backend-node) + SvelteKit CDK docs portal (moovv-fit-docs)
build_system: pnpm for both repos. Backend uses esbuild via scripts/build.js. Docs uses vite build + CDK for infra.
test_framework: Backend: Jest (npm test). Docs: Vitest (pnpm test) + CDK synth for infra validation.
build_command: Backend: npm run build. Docs: pnpm build && pnpm cdk:synth
test_command: Backend: npm test. Docs: pnpm test
verification_instructions: Backend: 1) npm run build 2) npm run type-check 3) npm test. Docs: 1) pnpm build 2) pnpm check 3) pnpm cdk:synth
environment_constraints: Both repos use pnpm as package manager. Backend migrations are .cjs files for Sequelize CLI compatibility. DB connection required for migration verification.
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: No auto-tests, code-first, max 20 words for status, use Powertools logger not console.log, explicit types not any. Migrations must be .cjs. After modifying code, update docs/architecture/db/manifest.md for DB changes, docs/architecture/api/manifest.md for route changes.

key_patterns.backend_models: Sequelize-typescript decorators (@Table, @Column, @BelongsTo, @HasMany) in src/database/models/. Models grouped by domain: core/, business/, infrastructure/. Export from index.ts in category folder, then from main index.ts.
key_patterns.backend_migrations: .cjs files in src/database/migrations/ with YYYYMMDDHHMMSS- prefix. Use queryInterface.createTable() for new tables. Raw SQL for platform schema tables (see 20260926000001).
key_patterns.backend_handlers: Lambda handlers in src/handlers/*.ts. Pattern: export handler function, use verifyAdminToken() for admin endpoints, createSuccessEnvelope/createErrorEnvelope for responses.
key_patterns.backend_serverless: Route definitions in serverless.yml functions section. Pattern: functionName → handler path → httpApi events with path/method.
key_patterns.backend_auth: Multi-pool JWT verification in src/shared/auth/multiPoolVerifier.ts. Admin auth in src/shared/middleware/adminAuth.ts uses verifyCognitoToken() then checks groups/roles.
key_patterns.docs_cdk: CDK stack in infra/lib/docs-stack.ts, constructs in infra/lib/constructs/. DocsAuth construct handles Cognito User Pool.
key_patterns.existing_platform_schema: Migration 20260926000001 already created platform.partner_developers, platform.partner_invite_codes, platform.api_keys tables with raw SQL in platform schema.

backend.src/database/models/: Sequelize models grouped by domain (core/, business/, infrastructure/)
backend.serverless.yml: Lambda function and API Gateway route definitions
